candidate_evidence.quote: Concurrent chemoradiation with temozolomide (TMZ) over 3 weeks (40 Gy in 15 fractions).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Biopsy or surgical resection performed ≤ 6 weeks prior to study entry

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent dose-escalated chemoradiation with temozolomide (TMZ) on the MR-Linac with weekly adaptation

coder_notes: Radiotherapy dose-escalation trial; temozolomide is background, not registered as an intervention but stated in the intervention text. Eligibility allows IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma as well as glioblastoma; IDH is not an entry requirement for a particular status. Gadolinium contrast not listed (passing mention).
